stories.title: Trump Expresses Support for a Unified Ireland During Visit
stories.summary: During his visit to Ireland, President Donald Trump stated that he would 'love' to see Ireland reunified, calling it 'fantastic' and 'inevitable.' His comments were made while attending the Irish Open golf tournament and meeting with Irish leaders, including Micheál Martin. Trump suggested that reunification could happen soon, despite Downing Street's commitment to the Good Friday Agreement.

stories.title: Investigation Underway After Train Derails in France, Injuring 44
stories.summary: A train derailed in Normandy, France, injuring 44 people, including one in critical condition. Authorities suspect sabotage after a fragment of rail was discovered on the track. The incident occurred while the train was transporting 186 passengers between Rouen and Caen.

stories.title: US Commemorates 25th Anniversary of 9/11 Attacks with Remembrance Ceremonies
stories.summary: On the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, Americans gathered in solemn remembrance of the nearly 3,000 lives lost. Ceremonies took place at significant sites including Ground Zero in New York, the Pentagon, and Shanksville, Pennsylvania, where families, survivors, and first responders reflected on the impact of that tragic day. A new memorial at the Pentagon aims to honor the 184 victims killed there.

stories.title: Houthis Gain Control of Strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Threatening Oil Exports
stories.summary: Iran-aligned Houthi rebels have captured Perim Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a critical shipping lane at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. This takeover follows the withdrawal of Yemeni government forces and poses a significant threat to Saudi oil exports. In response to recent drone attacks, Saudi Arabia has halted oil transfers through a major pipeline as a precautionary measure.

In response to the incident, Iraq has initiated investigations into the drone attack, which originated from an area near the Iranian border.

stories.title: Six Nigerians Extradited to the US for $6 Million Romance Scam
stories.summary: Six Nigerian nationals, allegedly part of the Black Axe criminal network, have been extradited to the United States from South Africa. They are accused of defrauding American women out of over $6 million through online romance scams. The extradition was confirmed by South African police and took place on Friday.

stories.title: Afghan Woman Deported in First Case of Alien Terrorist Removal Court
stories.summary: Nazira Haji Zada, a 47-year-old Afghan woman, has been deported following a ruling from the Alien Terrorist Removal Court. This case marks the first instance of the court's activity in many years, as the Justice Department accused her of being an 'alien terrorist.' Haji Zada's son and son-in-law were previously convicted in connection with a terrorism plot on election day.
